title: Jaipur
summary: Jaipur, in north-western India, was founded in 1727 by Sawai Jai Singh II as a planned trade capital on the plain, replacing Amber as capital of the princely state. Its grid plan blends Hindu, Mughal and Western ideas, and it is now Rajasthan's capital and most-populous city, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
